claim: CloudTrail does not send events over 256 KB to CloudWatch Logs or Amazon EventBridge, because each of them allows a maximum event size of 256 KB; starting with event version 1.05, CloudTrail events have a maximum size of 256 KB.

qualifiers.condition: This is the CloudTrail delivery rule; the current CloudWatch Logs quota for a log event is 1,024 KB (fact cloudwatch-logs-quota-event-size-1024-kb).
